canon.silhouette: wide and blocky - a rectangular plank door-shield taller and wider than the body it hides, held flat and frontal, carrying one broad iron band across its middle and an iron edge plate along its top rim, with only the top of the head and the eyes clearing that rim and two splayed feet below it
canon.reads_as: a banded door with a pair of eyes over the top of it

prompt.description: A shield bearer holding a door. A huge square plank shield, wider and taller than the person behind it, held flat and square to the front: bare timber planks, one broad iron band across the middle, and a flat iron plate along the top rim. The head sits low behind the shield so only the crown, brow and two dark eyes clear the rim. Two boots splay below the bottom edge.
must_include: a huge square plank shield wider and taller than the figure behind it
the shield held flat and square to the front, all four edges straight and axis-aligned
two vertical seams dividing the shield into three timber planks
exactly one broad horizontal iron band, crossing the full width at the middle and unbroken at the seams
a broad flat iron plate along the top rim, reading as the slab's thickness seen from above
the head sunk behind the shield so only the crown, brow and eyes clear the top rim
two boots splayed below the shield and no other body part visible
must_avoid: a round, kite, oval or curved shield
tilting or rotating the shield out of square
more than one iron band on the shield face
narrow, repeated or evenly spaced horizontal stripes
the shield breaking up into separate boards, slats or a crate
a lattice, grid, crossbar or diagonal bracing
a boss, spike, emblem or device on the shield face
lamp, torch, candle or visible flame
glow, halo, sparks or rays around any pixel
large solid black masses, heavy internal outlining or cast shadow
